metric_negative_strategy: all off-diagonal writers within each minibatch
metric_class_weighting: positive and negative means weighted equally within each condition
arabic_writer_representation: L2-normalized mean of p1 and p2 embeddings
english_writer_representation: L2-normalized mean of p3 and p4 embeddings
wgc_relation: cosine relation matrix among writers within each script
wgc_loss: mean squared difference between Arabic and English relation matrices
matched_control: same training setup with beta equal to zero
beta_calibration: fit-only loss and gradient-scale audit before verification evaluation
selection_role: checkpoint selection and go/no-go comparison only
